Our approach

What we would do
- We will define up to five audiences from AI-referred visits and their outcomes in the CJA data view, publish them to Real-Time Customer Profile, and agree with you how each audience is used in its existing channels.
- We will plan the upgrade path, implement Web SDK alongside the Analytics source connector for history, port reporting API use and exports, and migrate projects and components.

bank25.text: What ongoing optimization services do you provide after launch?

lines: O01: Monthly prompt and performance review [monthly]
O02: Content improvements for search and AI [monthly]
SI06: Monthly releases, monitoring and logs [monthly]
sections: After launch, across the Adobe products in this proposal, our ongoing services for Customer Journey Analytics, Brand Visibility, AEM Sites and Brand Concierge are these.

We will maintain the prompt portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages) and three competitors; review up to five prompt changes, read the Impact Measurement Engine's results when Adobe generates an analysis for an eligible deployment pilot, prioritize up to 10 actions, and hold one review with you using five business measures.

We will refresh four existing pages and create one new answer/knowledge page using approved facts and existing templates, in one locale with two review rounds. Each page change is logged once and tagged search, AI or both.
Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- After launch, across the Adobe products in this proposal, our ongoing services for Customer Journey Analytics, Brand Visibility, AEM Sites and Brand Concierge are these.

After launch
- We will maintain the prompt portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages) and three competitors; review up to five prompt changes, read the Impact Measurement Engine's results when Adobe generates an analysis for an eligible deployment pilot, prioritize up to 10 actions, and hold one review with you using five business measures.
- We will refresh four existing pages and create one new answer/knowledge page using approved facts and existing templates, in one locale with two review rounds. Each page change is logged once and tagged search, AI or both.
- Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.
